items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Eddie Barefield had just left Cab Calloway out here... [INTERVIEWER] How about Eddie Barefield? Did he start at the same time you did? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. We both started at the same time.

ctx.x: And do you remember some of the musicians that you hung out listening to? At night?
Oh, yeah. Eddie Byas and Don Byas, Art Tatum, Al Morgan and Eddie Barefield had just left Cab Calloway out here; and some of the local musicians -- let's see,
